_readme: OPERATOR-CURATED file — the Dispatch Wall on thedppod.html renders from this. Add REAL listener dispatches only (club charter: never fabricated, never generated). Each entry: 'did' is required; 'name' (e.g. 'Sarah, Calgary'), 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD, newest shown first), 'numbers' (the honest numbers line), 'shoutout', and 'episode_num' are optional. The wall shows the 9 most recent; an empty list renders the how-to-send state.
